_note: Draft knowledge base for the Parent Support agent (AI Club + Chinese). Oleg edits these answers. Anything not covered (fees, medical, other) is escalated to the Boss, never invented.
schedule: Thank you for your message. We can move your child to another group if there is a free place in the same age or level band. Children can join both AI Club and Chinese: the Scheduler never puts the two on the same day. Please reply with the days that suit you.
consent: Thank you. The data and photo consent form is part of the registration form. If you skipped it, reply to this email and we will send the link again.
tech: Children do not need to bring a device. The AI Club uses school computers, and children do not need personal accounts on AI websites.
safety: In the AI Club we only use child-safe tools chosen by the teacher, and children never enter personal information into AI tools. Lesson 6 is about online safety and deepfakes.
missed: No problem. Each lesson has a short summary and activity sheet, so your child can catch up at the next lesson.
chinese: Thank you. Chinese groups are formed by level: Beginner (ages 7 to 10 and 11 to 15), HSK1 and HSK2 to 3. If you are not sure about the level, the teacher does a short friendly check in the first lesson and can move your child to the right group.
